entry.title: Access status rechecked 11 Oct 2026, 05:17 UTC: unchanged (signups open, no new-user credit, API operational). Price, listed limits, model aliases and the model IDs on all six routes unchanged; API 90-day uptime 99.835% to 99.838% with no new incident listed; the status page now also lists api.us.typesafe.ai under "API status by geography". Two notices shown as on 10 Oct; none retired.

Benchmarks: three comparisons first listed as leads graded A from metric and results files opened at pinned commits (B38–B40); 37 graded rows (A 10, B 12, C 8, D 7). Two independent grade-A comparisons of Jev with OpenAI's Decisions API differ by task: Decisions API ahead on RPG move choices (B38); Jev ahead on exact judge score in Portuguese, level on routing and injection (B39).

Jev alternatives: the Decisions API evidence cell rebuilt from graded rows only (B38, B39; results differ by task); Microsoft-Decision-1 added as a second hosted API from another provider. Jev weights: not found on TypeSafe's site, docs, GitHub or Hugging Face (10 Oct). Of 31 listed substitutes: 12 model weights, 11 local runtimes, 4 request adapters, 2 classifier/LLM approaches, 2 hosted APIs from other providers (OpenAI, Microsoft).

Coding agents settled: Of 24 integrations read in source, 13 act on Jev's answer, 10 do not, 1 is unsettled. On a Jev error the 13: 5 let the call run, 3 hold, 5 fall back. jev-triage, the jev-for-all launcher and hermes-jev-mana (inert after the documented install) counted; Hoppin-Sorter/jev-router not settled.

When Jev fails recounted at 74 implementations: on a Jev error 38 stop or hold the action, 20 fall back, 8 let it through, 5 return no decision and 3 are advisory. The action goes ahead in 15 of 74. LanceDB's no-key cell is now fail-closed (read 11 Oct).

Jev reranker and Jev for RAG: jev-rerank-bench graded A as B40 (reranking-pipeline study; Jev and Cohere Rerank 4 Pro within noise); key finding recounted. Of 4 rerunnable graded reranking-pipeline studies, 2 come from parties with a stake and 2 state none (jev-pulse, 40 queries; jev-rerank-bench, Jev level with Cohere within noise); the other grade-A study measures relevance judgments.
Products: 99 rows (A 86, B 12, C 1) with jev-triage, the jev-for-all launcher and hermes-jev-mana added; none independently verified in production.
11 Oct research report: benchmark grades for three Jev vs substitute comparisons, coding-agent settlement, the failure-checklist recount and the real-time-control research result for run 14.

Access status rechecked 10 Oct 2026, 05:12 UTC (no run took place on 9 Oct): unchanged (signups open, no new-user credit, API operational). Price, listed limits, model aliases and the model IDs on all six routes unchanged; API 90-day uptime 99.831% to 99.835% with no new incident listed. Two notices shown: the subprocessor notice (2 Oct) and the rate-limit notice (3 Oct) were retired when their seven-day shelf life ended; both facts are unchanged and stay on data privacy and access status.

Jev alternatives retitled and sorted into five layers: Jev weights: not found on TypeSafe's site, docs, GitHub or Hugging Face (10 Oct). Of 30 listed substitutes: 12 model weights, 11 local runtimes, 4 request adapters, 2 classifier/LLM approaches, 1 OpenAI hosted API. OpenAI's Decisions API added as a hosted API from another provider; Jiwo 0.8B and TOD added; Strands Decider corrected; Jev-named models from other accounts in a separate box.

Coding agents updated: Of 22 integrations read in source, 10 act on Jev's answer, 10 do not and 2 are unsettled. On a Jev error the 10: 3 hold, 1 may ask the main model, 5 let the call run, 1 keeps its configured model.
When Jev fails recounted at 71 implementations: on a Jev error 38 stop or hold the action, 17 fall back, 8 let it through, 5 return no decision and 3 are advisory. The action goes ahead in 15 of 71.

Benchmarks: jev-pulse graded A (small sample, BM25-only baseline); three comparisons with code and data at a pinned commit listed as leads, not graded, because their metric code was not yet opened; 34 graded rows.

Jev reranker and Jev for RAG: key finding updated after jev-pulse was graded A. Of 3 rerunnable graded reranking-pipeline studies, 2 come from parties with a stake and 1 (jev-pulse: 40 queries, BM25-only baseline) states none; the other grade-A study measures relevance judgments. On a Jev error, of 5 implementations, 2 stop, 2 fall back, 1 passes unscreened passages.
Products: 96 rows (A 83, B 12, C 1) with jev-effort-router and jev-gateway added; none independently verified in production.
10 Oct research report: alternatives by layer, coding-agent integrations, the failure-checklist recount and benchmark leads. No run took place on 9 Oct.

Access status rechecked 8 Oct 2026, 05:14 UTC: unchanged (signups open, no new-user credit, API operational). Price, listed limits, model aliases (jev-latest and jev-preview point to jev-1.13.0), the model IDs on all six routes and the subprocessor list unchanged; the API's 90-day uptime moved from 99.828% to 99.831% with no new incident listed. Four notices shown as on 7 Oct; none retired.

New page: Jev reranker and Jev for RAG. The grade-A study measures relevance judgments, not reranking; both rerunnable graded pipeline studies come from parties with a stake. On a Jev error, of 5 implementations, 2 stop, 2 fall back, 1 passes unscreened passages.

New page: Jev inside SQL and document pipelines (pg-jev, sqlite-jev, sqlite3-jev, pg-redact, DocJev). On a Jev error, all 5 stop the query or request; pg-redact also stores text unredacted when a span's answer is missing or below 0.5. All 5 send row or document text out.

When Jev fails recounted: of 69 Jev implementations read in source, on a Jev error 38 stop or hold the action, 15 fall back, 8 let it through, 5 return no decision and 3 are advisory; the action goes ahead in 14 of 69. Five rows added under the nearest domains; the three SQL extensions are listed but not counted.
